result.topic_en: Gauss states a sign property of partial sums of an alternating binomial-coefficient series in quantities a, b, c, d, …, and notes the property still holds if the quantities alternate in sign from some point on.
result.transcription:
$a - kb + \frac{k.k-1}{1.2} c + \frac{k.k-1.k-2.}{1.2.3} - \text{u.s.w.}$
wo man auch abbricht, immer mit demselben
Zeichen behaftet wie das letzte zugezogene
Glied. Man wendet diess an
indem man von hinten anfängt. Der Satz
bleibt auch wahr wenn von irgend einer
Stelle an die Grössen a, b, c, d u.s.w.
alternirende Zeichen haben

methods.what: Sign property of truncated alternating binomial sums: each partial sum has the same sign as its last included term
methods.quote:
$a - kb + \frac{k.k-1}{1.2} c + \frac{k.k-1.k-2.}{1.2.3} - \text{u.s.w.}$
wo man auch abbricht, immer mit demselben
Zeichen behaftet wie das letzte zugezogene
Glied.

methods.what: Method of application: apply the property starting from the end of the series
methods.quote:
Man wendet diess an
indem man von hinten anfängt.

methods.what: Extension: the property also holds when the quantities a, b, c, d, … have alternating signs from some position onward
methods.quote:
Der Satz
bleibt auch wahr wenn von irgend einer
Stelle an die Grössen a, b, c, d u.s.w.

items.english: Wherever one breaks off, [the sum] always has the same sign as the last term included.

items.english: The theorem also remains true if, from some position onward, the quantities a, b, c, d, etc. have alternating signs.
